title: Water stored on land (NASA GRACE / GRACE-FO)
title_hi: ज़मीन में जमा पानी (NASA GRACE / GRACE-FO)
mission: NASA/DLR GRACE (2002-2017) and NASA/GFZ GRACE-FO (2018-) gravity satellites, JPL RL06.3Mv04 mascons
citation: Wiese, D. N., D.-N. Yuan, C. Boening, F. W. Landerer, M. M. Watkins, 2023: JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO Mascon Ocean, Ice, and Hydrology Equivalent Water Height Coastal Resolution Improvement (CRI) Filtered RL06.3Mv04. PO.DAAC, CA, USA. https://doi.org/10.5067/TEMSC-3JC634
explain: All the water stored on and under the land - groundwater, soil water, snow - weighed from space by gravity.
explain_hi: ज़मीन के ऊपर और नीचे जमा सारा पानी - भूजल, मिट्टी की नमी, बर्फ़ - गुरुत्वाकर्षण से अंतरिक्ष से तौला गया।
